title: Amazing Dungeon And Maze
description: 1 captured save. One original BASIC player; historical bugs remain.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: AMAZING DUNGEON AND MAZE
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Increasing lines; common pointer base 17125; exact end marker/EOF; byte-identical left/right payload
versions.startupSource:
5 XS=0:YS=1
10 PRINTTAB(20)"AMAZING PROGRAM"
30 CLS
90 PRINT "DIMENTIONS UP TO 63,21";
95 INPUT H,V
100 PRINT@0,"";:INPUT"DO YOU WANT A DUNJON OR A MAZE ";D$:CLS
101 FORWN=00TOH*2:SET(WN,0):SET(WN,V*2+2):NEXTWN
110 DIM W(H,V),V(H,V)
115 H1=H:V1=V
160 Q=0:Z=0:X=INT(RND(0)*H+1)
165 FORI=1TOH
170 IFI=XTHEN173

attribution.text: Adapted from Jack Hauber’s Amazing, published in BASIC Computer Games (Creative Computing). The exact intermediate edition is unverified.
